findings.title: Missing owner authorization check in withdraw
findings.detail: The docstring requires that only the owner may withdraw, but `caller` is never compared to `owner`, so any caller can withdraw from any balance.

findings.title: No insufficient-balance check; balance can go negative
findings.detail: `balance - amount` is returned without verifying `amount <= balance`, allowing overdraw into a negative balance.

findings.title: Amount type/NaN not validated
findings.detail: Non-numeric or NaN amounts bypass the `amount <= 0` guard (NaN compares false), so a NaN amount would be accepted and corrupt the balance.
